metadata.title: Wedbush starts Robinhood, Coinbase at Outperform in fintech coverage launch

content.text:
Investing.com -- Wedbush has launched coverage of the financial technology sector with Outperform ratings on Robinhood Markets, Coinbase Global, Visa and Mastercard, among others, telling investors that the industry's main growth driver has shifted.
Analyst Moshe Katri set price targets of $80 on Robinhood, $127 on Coinbase, $487 on Visa and $751 on Mastercard. Automatic Data Processing, Paychex and Sezzle were also rated Outperform.
Wedbush started Broadridge Financial Solutions, Circle Internet Group, Block, PayPal, Toast and Figure Technology Solutions at Neutral. It also took over coverage of Klarna, cutting the rating to Neutral from Outperform with a $14 target, and kept an Outperform rating on Paymentus.
Katri said the sector used to rely on consumers and small businesses switching from cash and checks to electronic payments.
"The bigger driver now is the pivot away from per-transaction fees, which keep compressing, toward value-added services (VAS) such as fraud, cyber, data, rewards, and identity tools," he wrote, adding that such services are defensive, grow quickly and carry higher margins.
"FinTech tends to benefit from inflation," Katri added.
Wedbush also initiated coverage of the tech-enabled services sector with a positive bias that it acknowledged runs against consensus.
It argued that the market has priced the group as the main casualty of generative AI, even though margins keep expanding.
"We describe the opportunity as the AI resilience trade: owning the businesses the market expects AI to displace, at prices that already assume it will," Wedbush said.
